value.rationale: A natural resource-constrained numerical integration design has a complete exact classification: below a sharp budget threshold location replication is optimal; above it spatial separation with uniquely equal precision is essential. This gives a dimensionless scale-dependent decision rule, an exact finite-budget risk, and a square-root design transition. The restriction to mirror sites is intrinsically motivated by Gaussian target and stationary even kernel, not a post hoc parameter slice. It supplies a reproducible benchmark for noisy Bayesian quadrature.
